engine_window.note: vllm:spec_decode_num_drafts_total is per-request; engine steps = d_drafts / concurrency, and the interval is the timestamped /metrics fetch span (metrics_interval_s), not the sleep window.

host_deviation.reason: rack06os2 rebooted mid-task and refused SSH on port 22 for ~10 min; rack06os1 was verified idle (8/8 dies, no running processes) and is the same Ascend950DT rack peer with the same image, so the TP2 measurement ran there.
host_deviation.identical_hardware: Ascend950DT_9582, 98304 MB HBM per die, 32 cube / 64 vector cores

extra.comparison_baseline: Task 1C: same checkpoint at TP8 gave TPOT 6.38 ms @c=4, 10.14 ms @c=40, 14.02 ms @c=128, with hcom_allReduce_ at 64.1% of device time at c=4

scenario_evidence.tpot_body_scope: client/profiled/sweep metrics retained separately in source fields; never body_forward_span_ms

runtime_refresh.observation_refresh_basis: explicit_controller_generation_map; source and prediction geometry unchanged

limitations: completion lower bounds preserve larger analytic work costs
HCOM elapsed includes protocol/peer wait and is not pure-link identification
